urlparse.status.idle: Paste a URL and it gets laid out piece by piece.
urlparse.warn.notUrl: That is not a complete URL (it has to start with http:// to be split up). Encoding still works.
urlparse.err.decode: There is a % sequence in here that cannot be decoded.
urlparse.say.nothingToDrop: There were no tracking parameters to remove.
urlparse.err.cannotStrip: Not a complete URL, so parameters cannot be removed.
